subject.title: GChat: Typing indicator persists after NO_REPLY + emoji reaction

question: Should maintainers adopt or rebuild the open fork PR at https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/155 as the fix path, or close it and queue a same-repo replacement?
rationale: The bug remains source-reproducible, but an open unmerged fork PR already closes this issue and is not maintainer-editable, so automation should not create a competing fix until maintainers choose the landing path.

options.title: Review or adopt the fork PR
options.body: Refresh or rebuild the fork PR against current main, add proof, and preserve contributor credit if it remains the canonical fix path.

options.title: Close candidate and replace
options.body: Close the fork PR as non-viable and queue a narrow same-repo replacement that fixes the placeholder lifecycle with tests and proof.

options.title: Keep waiting
options.body: Leave the issue paired with the fork PR only if maintainers expect the contributor to return with updates and proof soon.

recommendation.title: Review or adopt the fork PR
recommendation.body: Refresh or rebuild the fork PR against current main, add proof, and preserve contributor credit if it remains the canonical fix path.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Google Chat reply-delivery history and maintainer landing comments make this the strongest available routing signal.
